isolation: Use per-task stack and synthetic data only; do not send messages or contact real applicants

scenarios.title: Semantic evidence and late changes
scenarios.given: Fixture with card support, type-only support, contradiction, missing vectors and more than five matches
scenarios.when: Search mixed wishes, then delete/reserve/change a selected stone before commit
scenarios.then: Hard filters precede limits; contradiction veto holds; bounded ranking/counts truthful; partial list not padded; one all-lost refresh maximum; no fabricated individual color
scenarios.method: Controlled semantic integration and real-model qualification

scenarios.title: Knowledge grounding and attribution
scenarios.given: Versioned factual and fictional passages including the source qualification
scenarios.when: Ask care, personality, ritual and a mixed selection question; open Sources
scenarios.then: Fiction explicitly labelled; individual claims supported; same-version citations resolve; no secret keys/scores; missing evidence acknowledged; deleted projection does not break retained citations
scenarios.method: Source parsing, independent answer rubric and browser disclosure checks

scenarios.title: Atomic document replacement
scenarios.given: An indexed source and a new version with removed topics
scenarios.when: Import valid/oversized/malformed sources, fail embedding/commit acknowledgement, replay key after source overwrite and delete projection
scenarios.then: Old projection survives confirmed preparation failure; no partial publication; replay does not read/republish the new source; source versions/citations retained; forbidden paths never supplied

scenarios.title: Atomic business event and publisher
scenarios.given: A stone mutation with injected outbox failure and a broker outage
scenarios.when: Commit and roll back changes, reuse an event UUID with a changed payload, recover the broker and fail an event-specific route
scenarios.then: Business and outbox changes are atomic; changed payload is rejected; outage preserves the attempt budget; three event-specific failures lead to durable DLQ transfer; acknowledgement alone marks delivery; duplicate deliveries remain permitted

scenarios.title: Consumer restart and tombstones
scenarios.given: A version 2 deletion, an older update, a malformed record and a failed embedding
scenarios.when: Redeliver, reorder and restart processing; simulate dependency loss and occupied model capacity
scenarios.then: No deleted projection is resurrected; stale versions invoke no model; attempt counts survive restart; dependency outages wait; source offsets advance only after database commit or acknowledged DLQ transfer
scenarios.method: Kafka consumer integration and fault cases

scenarios.title: End to end reindex
scenarios.given: Existing stones, an orphan projection and one active ALL job
scenarios.when: Create, update and delete stones during the job; restart; hold Kafka unavailable; supersede a target version and dead-letter one item
scenarios.then: Creation remains available; high-water-mark scope is finite; resume does not repeat completed items; ENQUEUED is not DONE; counts lead to SUCCEEDED or COMPLETED_WITH_ERRORS with item evidence
scenarios.method: Reindex job integration and operator status inspection

scenarios.title: Environment loss during integration
scenarios.given: A requested batch with declared components and isolated endpoints
scenarios.when: Stop a required database, API or browser dependency between precheck and completion; change content after a passing run
scenarios.then: The batch starts only after every prerequisite passes; the watcher detects loss and marks BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT; changed content invalidates evidence; original application data is untouched

implementation: Each browser-required ticket creates its own executable quality/e2e/<TASK-ID>/*.spec.ts suite for that ticket contribution; full scenarios are aggregated at release
